{"task": {"learned_policy": "Read the complete agreement and classify each of the two hypotheses from operative provisions governing the receiving party's disclosure or access to Confidential Information. Entail nda-5 when an operative clause expressly permits disclosure, access, or internal sharing to at least some of the receiving party's employees; permission to a defined group such as Representatives also counts when the operative clause authorizes that group and its definition includes employees. Entail nda-7 when an operative clause permits at least one genuinely external representative class covered by the hypothesis, such as consultants, contractors, agents, attorneys, accountants, legal or financial advisers, or other professional advisers. Purpose limitations, need-to-know requirements, confidentiality duties, and similar safeguards are intrinsic qualifications on an express permission and do not prevent Entailment. By contrast, a requirement to obtain new prior consent or written authorization is not itself a standing permission for the queried recipient class. Return Contradiction when an operative clause expressly prohibits disclosure to the queried class—or, for nda-7, prohibits disclosure to third parties generally—and no operative exception independently permits a covered class; a consent-only escape does not defeat that contradiction. Return NotMentioned when neither an operative permission nor an applicable express prohibition is established. Definitions, recitals, descriptions of who may disclose information, lists of Representatives unconnected to an operative authorization, and mentions of employees or advisers merely as confidential-information subjects, responsible persons, or parties' personnel do not establish permission. Do not import safeguards or recipient classes from another agreement, and do not infer unstated roles, consent, or permissions.", "source_spans": [{"id": 0, "field": "source_text", "start": 0, "end": to the professional practice(s) for which I am inquiring."}, {"id": 8, "field": "source_text", "start": 1915, "end": 2263, "text": "I hereby acknowledge and agree that all information pertaining to "}, {"id": 9, "field": "source_text", "start": 2263, "end": 2434, "text": "I further agree not to write or mark the Appraisal(s), nor shall I copy or reproduce any information in any manner whatsoever without the prior consent of ROI Corporation."}, {"id": 10, "field": "source_text", "start": 2435, "end": 2723, "text": "The Receiving Party shall take all practical steps to keep the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information confidential and shall restrict access to the Confidential Information to those agents and professional advisers to whom disclosure is necessary in pursuit of the Approved Purpose. "}, {"id": 11, "field": "source_text", "start": 2723, "end": 2950, "text": "Each Party shall inform all such employees, agents and professional advisers of the provisions of this Agreement and shall be responsible for ensuring compliance with the said provisions by all agents and professional advisers."}, {"id": 12, "field": "source_text", "start": 2951, "end": 3268, "text": "Receiving Party acknowledges and agrees that due to the sensitive nature of the Confidential Information, any breach of this Agreement would cause irreparable harm to the Disclosing Party and that the Disclosing Party shall therefore be entitled to equitable relief in addition to all other remedies available at law."}, {"id": 13, "field": "source_text", "start": 3269, "end": 3376, "text": "In addition, the Receiving Party acknowledges that the following specific Confidential Information, namely:"}, {"id": 14, "field": "source_text", "start": 3377, "end": 3891, "text": "Knowledge of the identity of the Disclosing Party, coupled with the fact that that the Disclosing Party’s practice(s) are for sale, or that the Disclosing Party has commissioned appraisal(s) for the possible sale of same would, if disclosed by the Receiving Party and such information thereby came to the knowledge of STAFF (either employees or associates) of the practices, cause significant damages to the Disclosing Party though departure of STAFF and/or Patients, which damages would be difficult to quantify. "}, {"id": 15, "field": "source_text", "start": 3891, "end": 4297, "text": "Accordingly, Receiving Party acknowledges that a breach of this confidentiality agreement with respect to this specific
